source_pdf: Antseed - AI agents for neobanks (Solid case study).pdf
source_of_claims: User-supplied PDF, with the Solid launch date, six-model list, Opus retail price and cashback caps cross-checked against solid.xyz/post/ai-agents-antseed on 2026-11-17. Network metrics and other offer details retain the source snapshot.

coverage.title: AI agents, inside your neobank
coverage.story: One API key, network pricing and payment from the balance already in the neobank.

coverage.title: The opportunity
coverage.story: Existing AI spend leaves the app; agents create daily use. Cashback, tiers, provider choice, agent readiness and conditional usage rewards support the bank offer.

coverage.title: The partner offer
coverage.story: Antseed model access, network prices, bank-selected rewards. Eligible usage can earn Antseed Points; each Thursday, Points determine a share of weekly ANTS rewards, which partners may keep, pass on or split under program terms.

coverage.title: Pricing
coverage.story: Claude Opus network-median price for a healthy paid listing and 50% partner cashback; all three other price examples retained. Solid retail price and caps disclosed. Discounts calculated from displayed USD-per-million-input-token prices.

coverage.title: The network and gateway
coverage.story: Mainline DHT discovery, direct routing, per-use payment, provider failover and signed responses/model checks. Gateway endpoint, per-customer/agent keys, budgets, access and per-key usage support rewards.

coverage.title: Network snapshot
coverage.story: The four network metrics retain the source snapshot of 13 November 2026 with AntSeedStats CC BY 4.0 attribution.

coverage.title: The Solid case study
coverage.story: 8 November launch and 12 November follow-up. Rewards tab, 50% cashback for everyone, six top models on one key, 20% Ultra/10% Prime AI subscription cashback, stacking and zero monthly fees as quoted in the brief.

coverage.title: Your launch
coverage.story: Solid playbook: reward placement, clear offer and tiers. Four-step intro, sandbox, in-app integration and co-launch plan; invitation to make AI a reason to open the app.

editorial_decisions.decision: The testimonial is explicitly marked draft, pending Mark Smargon approval. It is not reproduced as an approved quote; its retention thesis is already covered by slides 1, 2 and 8.
Lowest-listing promotional price cards omitted as redundant, rather than conflated with the median healthy paid-listing pricing methodology used on page 5.

Solid’s 6% APY and Visa acceptance describe the broader app, rather than the AI offer. The short version identifies Solid as a stablecoin money app. These secondary context details do not become a current financial claim.

Claude Opus 5.5.network_label: network median for a healthy paid listing

limitations: Prices and network figures are the PDF snapshot, not today’s values.
Solid offers and launch statements are historical, as represented in the supplied brief; launch date, six-model list, Opus retail price and cashback caps were publicly cross-checked.
Reward eligibility, token value, cashback funding and final program terms require partner agreement. No fixed investment return is asserted.
Signed provenance and model verification do not establish cryptographic model identity for every response.
Prompt and answer retention can differ by upstream provider.
reward_model: Eligible paid buyer usage earns Points; variable share of weekly ANTS rewards under public program terms. No fixed conversion or guaranteed bank revenue.

factual_review_2026_11_17.pricing: Historical median examples distinguished from Solid retail. GPT-6.1 Sol corrected to 2.00 / 0.089 / 0.0445 per million input tokens; 98% rounded savings.
factual_review_2026_11_17.points: Eligible paid usage; variable weekly share, no fixed conversion or guaranteed bank revenue.
factual_review_2026_11_17.data_handling: Selected providers process requests; Solid stores billing counts, not prompts or answers; provider practices vary.
factual_review_2026_11_17.stats: Trailing + added; historical read dates retained.
